_doc: In-game A/B of the sun prototype (shaders/features/dsrle_features.fxh, DSRLE_SUN_A, gain 2, cap 0.6). Character-region (1650,880 560x1180 of 3840x2160) mean linear luminance change in EV. captures/sun1 (vanilla vs A/B, normal exposure, vanilla DrawParam) and captures/sun2 (one restart with sun_A, DrawParam with every LightBank/s_LightBank colA_s set to 0/30/58 white, exposure pinned at 0.18).

anor_interior.note: indoors: leak through the shadowed gate

darkroot_garden.note: bonfire flicker + auto exposure; character row colA_s 0

conclusions: colA_s controls the sun per light row as designed; colA_s 0 removes the Anor Londo interior leak.
On characters the effect is view-dependent; from the bonfire camera (character's back) it is +0.05..0.2 EV at the cap.
Painted World: the sun mostly lands on Snow-family ground (no light map), which is already near white: clipped pixels 32.6% -> 34.3% at s58. Exclude Snow from the sun by default.
Firelink and Parish character regions are dominated by bonfire flicker; judge the sun from crops, not region means, there.
